digest.component_or_area: push.py lock-artifact exclusion and failure handling
propositions: Concurrent first-time callers to _ignore_lock_artifacts can interleave buffered appends and tear exclude patterns into corrupt half-lines, silently disabling lock-artifact exclusion.
The exclusion-write failure path (push.py:651-655) and git status failure path (push.py:673-678) lack direct test coverage with observable failure outcomes.
Lock artifacts (.ticket-write.lock and .ticket-write.lock.d/ contents) must not appear in committed tree history even when present on disk during locked git operations.
Single atomic os.write to O_APPEND descriptor on POSIX eliminates interleaving corruption; duplicate whole lines remain possible and are acceptable since git idempotently applies repeated patterns.
